title: Persona Profile List — payload
description: Enumerate the holder's profiles. Compositions only — entries are returned, values are not.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a prior response. A producer MUST NOT construct or parse one.

Response.title: Persona Profile List — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/profile/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/profile/list/1.0#response. Profiles are returned as composed; there is no resolve option here, because resolving every profile in one call would decrypt the holder's entire pool to answer a question about names.

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain. Its absence is the only exhaustion signal.
